component.name: MyNote
component.summary: A fast, lightweight, and super easy-to-use native Linux note-taking application

description.p: MyNote is a distraction-free, super-fast, and open-source note-taking application built natively for Linux using Rust, GTK4, and Libadwaita.

ul.li: Instant startup and ultra-low resource usage
Instant automatic saving with zero data loss
Live Markdown preview and split-view editing
Tags, pinning / favorites, and full-text instant search
Markdown formatting toolbar and extensive keyboard shortcuts
Trash bin protection with restore capability
Export and import for Markdown (.md) and Plain Text (.txt)

description.p: Fixed crashes triggered by the pin/format actions and fast typing, and added robust CLI argument handling for --new-note.
Initial stable open-source release of MyNote for Linux.
